about: Water names in Wisconsin's records that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for WI: the waters the Milwaukee Metropolitan Sewerage District's Storm Update posts name, one row per name and county, with the number of reports, the town and sources; no points (the posts give none). Records naming no water are counted in by_reason. EPA's outfall registry gives every CSO and plant outfall its receiving water separately. Written by scripts/wi_report_water_names.py.
